sources.name: staj-synth generator
sources.description: Synthetic retail population (3 banks, 3 000 clients) with honest personas and planted mule schemes.

sources.name: Planted mule schemes
sources.description: Fan-in stars, relay chains, same-hand rings, slow mules, scam victims inserted by the generator with known labels.

sources.name: CNB pilot rules A/B/C
sources.description: Generic rule shapes inspired by public supervisory discussion; thresholds are our assumptions.

sources.name: FX rates
sources.description: Fixed placeholder rates, not market data.

limitations: All metrics are measured on synthetic data generated by the same team that wrote the detectors; real-world performance is unknown.
Escalation matrix is a placeholder, not a bank policy.
Slow mules (lag > 72 h) are mostly missed.
LLM explanations are checked by rule-based QA, which can miss subtle errors; a human must read them.
legal_note: PSI (private set intersection) minimises what banks reveal to each other; it is not a legal basis for sharing. Any cross-bank exchange needs its own legal basis and legal review.
